task.title: Planner Cook slot: pick the right recipe instead of silently creating one
task.description:
Reported from phone testing on the dev site (2026-11-18).

Seen:
- Typing a name into a Cook slot did not bring up the existing recipe of that name.
- Leaving the field (blur) created a new bare recipe with that name.
- Typing a name first and importing a real recipe of the same name later leaves two recipes with one name, and no way to say which one the slot means.

Wanted:
- A recipe picker in the Cook slot that searches the Recipe Book as you type, so an existing recipe can be chosen deliberately.
- No recipe created just by typing and leaving the field. Creating a new one should be an explicit choice (for example a 'Create "name"' row in the picker), or the slot keeps plain text until a recipe is attached.
- A way to change which recipe a slot points at, and to attach a recipe to a slot that only has a typed name.
- When two recipes share a name, show enough to tell them apart (source, ingredient count).

Notes:
- Today convex/planner.ts matches by normalised meal key against the newest saved recipe, else calls insertUserRecipe with empty ingredients. Autocomplete is the browser's datalist, which is patchy on iPhone Safari; that may be why the existing recipe was not offered. Reproduce before assuming.
- Related: 'Delete a recipe from the Recipe Book'.

Added 2026-11-18, with a phone screenshot (Android, Brave):
- The browser's suggestion list opens on top of the field being typed in, hiding the text and the slot. It also covers the neighbouring slot's type buttons.
- The list offers every meal name with no filtering that matches what was typed (typing 'P' listed 'Shrimp').
- It showed both 'Shrimp Peperonata' and a mistyped 'Shrimp Pepero ata', an example of the stray recipes created on blur.
- So suggestions do appear on Android; the failure there is placement, not absence. Replace the browser datalist with the app's own picker, anchored below the field (or a bottom sheet on phones) so the field stays visible above the keyboard.
